The application stands disposed of.
This is an application seeking regular bail in FIR No. 647/2022 dated 02.11.2022, under Sections 363/365/366/368/376/109 IPC and Sections 4/17 POCSO Act, registered at Police Station - Jaitpur.

It is stated by Mr Singh, learned counsel that in the present case there are improvements in statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C and there are no specific allegations against the applicant but merely bald averments.
Issue notice.
Mr Utkarsh, learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
He seeks and is granted four weeks to file a response/status report.
